newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Dini flies to Tirana to meet Berisha.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Dini flies to Tirana to meet Berisha.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini was flying to Tirana on Sunday at the invitation of the Albanian government and opposition leaders, a foreign ministry spokesman said.

Dini will hold talks with President Sali Berisha on how to move ahead to democratic elections, the spokesman added. Berisha has offered the opposition Socialist Party a place in an interim government and has extended an amnesty to armed rebels.
The spokesman said Dini was about to leave for Tirana and was likely to return in the evening. He had no precise details of his schedule.
Italy welcomed offers made by Berisha earlier in a televised broadcast, which included the creation of a "government of national reconciliation" and an offer to hold new elections within two months.
"We see this positively," the spokesman said.

He said Dini was invited to Tirana "in consideration of the positive role which Italy has played in seeking to resolve the crisis". The West has stepped up efforts in past days to resolve the insurrection gripping the south of Albania.
